description: This file declares factory classes and creation functions for PUSCH decoders, demodulators, and processors, including configurations for hardware and software implementations, within the ocudu namespace. It also defines related factory interfaces and configuration structures for 5G NR physical layer processing.

classes.name: pusch_decoder_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating PUSCH decoder instances.

classes.name: pusch_demodulator_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating PUSCH demodulator instances.

classes.name: pusch_processor_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating PUSCH processor and validator instances.

classes.name: ulsch_demultiplex_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating ULSCH demultiplex instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the respective factory or object.

methods.name: create_pusch_decoder_empty_factory
methods.description: Creates a factory for an empty PUSCH decoder with specified PRB and layer limits.

methods.name: create_pusch_decoder_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-based PUSCH decoder factory with given configuration.

methods.name: create_pusch_decoder_factory_hw
methods.description: Creates a hardware-accelerated PUSCH decoder factory with given configuration.

methods.name: create_pusch_demodulator_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-based PUSCH demodulator factory with specified equalizer, precoder, demodulation, EVM, and PRG factories.

methods.name: create_pusch_processor_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-based PUSCH processor factory with specified configuration.

methods.name: create_pusch_processor_pool
methods.description: Creates a PUSCH processor pool with specified regular and UCI factory configurations.

methods.name: create_ulsch_demultiplex_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software ULSCH demultiplex factory.
